crossRefs.note: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
My God, turn your ear, and hear. Open your eyes, and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name…
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
